prompt_records.prompt: Six-second photorealistic single continuous shot, fixed camera, physical cause and target visible. Capture close, detailed, realistic sound synchronized with the visible action, strong enough to suit a dramatic game effect without clipping. No music, speech, voice, chiptune, synthesizers, artificial cinematic risers, cartoon effects, montage, edits or captions. Do not impose three takes: perform one complete event, with a clean natural onset and decay, and leave quiet when the event finishes. A strong local gust lifts dry leaves into one continuous visible outdoor vortex and then the leaves settle. Capture a forceful but natural moving air layer and detailed dry leaf rustle that rise and decay together over roughly 2.417 seconds. No footfalls or continuous motor; do not impose three separate takes.
prompt_records.evidence: generation prompt recorded with crop SHA
